notes: Parsed to YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-04). Rows with no recognisable month label are skipped.

source_workbook: Pipe / Garden / HDPE / Moulding M/C Summary
header_in_sheet: MACHINE / MOULD MACHINE column (merged cell; carried forward across months)
notes: Merged cell — appears once then blank; parser carries it forward. Prefixed with plant code to form the full machine key (e.g. "PIPE M/C-1").

source_workbook: Moulding M/C Summary (primary); others where present
header_in_sheet: Column immediately before the month column
notes: Merged cell carried forward like machine label. Used as both mould and material fields.

header_in_sheet: Ideal Hours (merged; carried forward across months)
notes: Merged cell. If blank for a month row the last non-blank value is used. A zero means the machine was not planned that month.
Run time actually recorded. Rows where both Actual Hours and Output are zero are skipped (future month).

header_in_sheet: Actual Output (KG) / Output (KG) / Output (PCS) — header varies by plant
notes: Raw produced quantity. Stored % cells in the sheet are ignored — all ratios are recomputed here.

header_in_sheet: Ideal Output column (=ideal rate; e.g. 120 kg/hr)
feeds_these_metrics: Output Efficiency = Actual Output ÷ (Actual Hours × Ideal Rate)
notes: Merged cell; parser stores it as ideal_rate and computes ideal_output = actual_hours × ideal_rate. Never read from the stored Output Efficiency % cell.

header_in_sheet: Rejection (KG) / Rejection — the % column is deliberately ignored
notes: Rejection % is always recomputed. The stored rejection % cell in the sheet is never read.

section: DAILY GRAIN — Per-Month Daily Workbooks (one workbook per plant per month; currently active for PIPE and GARDEN)

header_in_sheet: Date label in repeating column group header — e.g. "Apr, 1" or "01-Apr-26"
notes: Detected as day-of-month (1–31). Combined with the workbook's YYYY-MM to produce the full ISO date (e.g. 2026-04-01). Non-date headers (merged blanks / summary labels) are skipped.

header_in_sheet: MACHINE / M/C NO. row label (left side of the wide matrix)
notes: Row label. Rows labelled TOTAL / PART-1 / PART-2 / %AGE are skipped. Must match an M/C-n key from the monthly grid (M or MACHINE + number) — otherwise the row is dropped at join to prevent mis-joins.

header_in_sheet: Run Hours sub-column inside each date group (sub-header contains "RUN")
notes: Hours actually run on that machine on that date. Rows where both Run Hours and Output are zero are skipped.

header_in_sheet: Output sub-column inside each date group (sub-header contains "OUTPUT")
notes: Actual output for that machine on that date. For PIPE: this is net-of-rejection (gross output minus rejects) — causing a ~6.6 % reconciliation gap vs the monthly grid which records gross output. This is documented as a known honest discrepancy.

header_in_sheet: Rejection sub-column inside each date group (sub-header contains "REJECT")
notes: Rejection for that machine on that date.

section: JOINED FROM MONTHLY GRID (not read from the daily file — looked up at load time)

source_workbook: Looked up from the cached monthly Record for the same machine + month
feeds_these_metrics: Output Efficiency (daily) = Daily Output ÷ (Run Hours × Ideal Rate)
notes: The daily workbook does not carry an ideal rate column. It is joined from the matching monthly M/C-n row so that per-day ideal output is consistent with the monthly engine.

source_workbook: Derived: monthly Ideal Hours ÷ count of active days that month
feeds_these_metrics: Utilisation (daily) = Run Hours ÷ (Monthly Ideal Hours ÷ Active Days)
notes: Ensures a full-month daily rollup reconciles exactly with the monthly Utilisation figure. Active days = days where either Run Hours or Output > 0 for that machine.
